title: Density of smooth points over an arbitrary field
statement: Let $K$ be a field and $h:Z\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ a locally finitely presented morphism of schemes [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Suppose $Z$ is geometrically reduced over $K$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. The smooth locus, meaning the union of all open subschemes $W\subseteq Z$ for which $h|_W$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], is dense in $Z$.
